messages:
maya: Heads up  got a user report: new SDK package exports are causing our Next/Vite starters to throw module resolution errors. Looks like a subtle ESM/CJS + types interaction. tagging @ralph for bundler parity and @toni for package owner.

maya: Minimal repro:
1) npx create-next-app@latest --ts test-starter
2) yarn add @redwood/js-sdk@canary
3) import { createClient } from '@redwood/js-sdk' in a page -> dev server crashes with resolver error.

maya: Snippet of the shipped package.json exports:```json
{"exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},"./client":{"import":"./dist/esm/client.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/client.cjs"}}}```

maya: Error (Vite):
[vite] Failed to resolve entry for package "@redwood/js-sdk". The package may have incorrect "exports" or "module" field.

ralph: That's the classic conditional-exports + extension problem. Many bundlers prefer `import` -> .js not .mjs, and some resolvers choke on .cjs in exports when expecting .js for CJS. Also editors can get confused when `types` exist but are not listed on each exported subpath.

toni: Our intent was to be explicit about ESM vs CJS files. We landed .mjs/.cjs pair to be strict. Maybe too strict. Quick rollback plan: revert exports to the previous explicit map with .js files and publish a patch.

maya: Meanwhile users can deep-import `@redwood/js-sdk/dist/esm/index.js` as a temporary workaround. We'll add that to the starter README.

ralph: Longer-term: recommend these changes in package layout
- ship `.js` ESM bundles in dist alongside `.mjs` (so import paths without .mjs work)
- provide `.js` CJS artifacts instead of `.cjs` where possible to avoid bundler edge cases
- include "types" per export (e.g. "./client": { "types": "./dist/client.d.ts", ... })
- add "./package.json": "./package.json" to exports so some tooling can read package metadata

toni: Also add a release check that runs a quick resolution test using Node's resolver and esbuild's resolver across a matrix of consumer patterns (bare import, subpath import, deep import) so we catch these before publishing.

pkg-ci: Release guardian: examples smoke tests failed on preview: "vite build" exit code 1. Blocking publish.

onboard-bot: Suggested communication: post workspace message to #general and update docs/quickstart with deep-import workaround and ETA for patch.

maya: I'll open hotfix PR and tag for fast-track. Also adding issue #4510 to track export policy (include tests & docs).

toni: After hotfix, let's standardize the SDK monorepo packaging: export policy doc + pre-release job that validates exports against our canonical pattern.

ralph: One more gotcha: TypeScript's module resolution sometimes ignores root "types" when exports are present; adding `types` into every exported subpath fixes editor warnings. We'll include that in the patch.

maya: Thanks all. I'll kick off the revert and update starters with the workaround. Will post the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
